relations.condition: Karabash smelter production capability increasing by ~115kt to ~0.87Mt

Feed for the plant is currently sourced from RCC’s Aleksandrinskoe and Barsuchy Log mines in Russia and from the Koktaus mine in Kazakhstan, while future feed will also be derived from the company’s Miheevskoe project
The smelter’s output was estimated to be 67kt last year and is expected to rise slightly to 75kt for this year and next

Mexican smelter production capability is forecast to increase by 151kt during the forecast period, reflecting higher utilisation of existing capability from the country’s La Caridad smelter following the anticipated re-start of the company’s Buenavista del Cobre mine (formerly Cananea) in 2011
This more than offsets the loss of San Luis Potosi, which closed last year having produced just 1kt
Russian Copper Co aims to modernise and expand capacity its Karabash smelter from 75kt/a to 100kt/a by 2013 at a cost of $310M
from 20kt/a expected this year to 130kt/a by 2013
from 200kt/a in 2010 to 400kt/a from mid 2011 with plans to increase further, to 600kt/a and then 800kt/a
disassemble and grade the imported scrap (including everything from transformers to whole motors) via hand sorting
